name: sambhav-plugins
description: Personal Claude Code plugins for managing context and cost.

plugins.name: ctx-kit
plugins.description: Context tree loaded on demand, decisions as ADRs, zero-token drift/rename checks, lossless handoffs, session-size advisor.

plugins.name: read-guard
plugins.description: Unchanged re-reads become a one-line stub, re-reads after a change become a diff, stale native 'unchanged' stubs are corrected; built-in savings stats.
